title: Chapter 648
text:
"So, this is the 'Indestructible Body' Black Star …"

"The strength of his body is even more exaggerated than the rumors say. With such a powerful recovery ability, only a Beyond Grade A Super will be able to kill him easily."

"To be able to take on the eight Vanguard Officials of the Tyrant alone, as expected of the strongest general under the Dragon Emperor. Just where did Ames find such a powerful person?"

Han Xiao's performance shocked the many Calamity Grade Supers of Section Zero.

The Arc Light Organization and the other organizations were shocked. They had originally thought that Black Star was overestimating himself and would sacrifice himself like their own high-level combatants. Who would have thought that while they were all Calamity Grade Supers, they were different?

Wrothers was shocked, and he said, "There's something strange about his body. A portion of the power we unleashed was absorbed by his cells, allowing him to recover quickly."

Jaeger's expression was solemn. "I noticed it too."

The Chief Vanguard Official was extremely experienced and quickly discovered the theory behind Han Xiao's Indestructible Body. Wrothers's eyes narrowed, and he thought of a countermeasure.

"He doesn't recover instantly, and there's a limit to his strength. As long as our attacks exceed the threshold, we will be able to cause effective damage to him. We need to unleash explosive and continuous attacks without giving him any time to breathe. Only then will we have a chance to kill him."

Wrothers's eyes were sharp, and his conclusion was close to the truth.

Hearing that Black Star could be killed, the other seven could not help but heave a sigh of relief.

Black Star's endurance had shocked them. The damage dealt by the eight of them together was enough to cause continuous landslides. Even they did not dare to use their bodies to take on such damage. Just like when facing Han Xiao's Mech Army, they mainly dodged, not daring to be focused on.

Looking at Han Xiao, who was exercising his shoulders in the middle of the encirclement, Wrothers's tone sank.

"Don't overestimate Black Star. Although it's very difficult to kill him, as long as we destroy his mechanical army, his threat will be greatly reduced. One person will be enough to hold him back."

However, Wrothers's goal was not just to hold back Black Star. He wanted to kill Black Star. If the eight Vanguard Officials were unable to deal with an opponent of the same level, their reputation would take a huge hit. Only by killing Black Star would they be able to establish their prestige and intimidate the members of Section Zero.

"Let's attack together and change tactics. Don't split up."

As soon as he finished speaking, the eight of them once again besieged Black Star. Wrothers had said that only with high burst damage and continuous damage would they have a chance of killing Black Star. Only when the eight of them worked together would their damage output be the most terrifying.

Han Xiao had expected that the eight of them would try a second time. The members of the Bloodshed Land were all brawns and would not give up so easily.

It was not that he did not resist at all. He opened his arms wide and pulled. Mechanical Force surged out like lightning. Even if the Mech Army was reduced to less than a tenth, the mechanical parts floating in the air were still his weapons!

Countless mechanical parts turned into a torrent and gathered toward Han Xiao. Under the effect of Mechanical Force, they quickly transformed and joined together, turning into giant mechanical hands and modified cannon barrels.

The iron fists smashed through the flames, and the laser cannons pierced through the darkness.

If the battlefield was not in a silent vacuum environment, the momentum would have been extremely shocking.

At this moment, the multi-colored lights crisscrossed and exploded soundlessly. Amidst the deathly stillness, there was an unparalleled danger!

Grade B Supers could not even withstand the aftermath of the battle between Han Xiao and the eight Vanguard Officials.

This ability to directly modify mechanical parts into mechanical weapons not only used [Waste Modification] but also the effects of [Basic Machinery Construction] and [Mechanical Force Combat Technique]. It consumed a lot of energy, but with the ferocious attacks of the eight Vanguard Officials, Han Xiao did not lack energy at all.

Bang bang bang!

Their muscles collided again and again, and bright energy rings exploded!

The battle became more and more intense!

Because Wrothers had found the trick, the eight Vanguard Officials used high-explosive and high-endurance attacks. They cooperated well and attacked endlessly, making Han Xiao suffer the destruction of wind and rain every second.

Heavy punches that could shake mountains landed on his muscles, and high-intensity shockwaves that were comparable to battleship main cannons burned his bones. In order to pursue explosive power, the eight Vanguard Officials attacked with all their might, and all kinds of Pugilist skills greeted Han Xiao one after another.

Their fists were like meteors, and the stars fell like rain!

Bang bang bang!

The dull vibrations passed through his bones and muscles, all the way to his brain. Han Xiao felt like he was a piece of cake that was being hammered continuously. The control of the eight Vanguard Officials was very strong, and he was being hit ninety percent of the time. His counterattacks could only cause some trouble and were not enough to interrupt the attacks of the Vanguard Officials.

There was a limit to the conversion of energy and health, and he could only recover twenty-eight percent of his health every second. With the eight of them increasing their explosive power, their output efficiency soared.

The damage per second had already reached forty to fifty thousand, which exceeded his recovery speed.

This damage was extremely terrifying. If a normal Calamity Grade Super were to take all the attacks with his body, he would be reduced to a pile of broken corpses in just two seconds.

Thankfully, my Strengthened Life talent has already become advanced, giving me almost twenty thousand health. Otherwise, my recovery speed would not be able to keep up.

Enduring the intense pain, Han Xiao gritted his teeth and maintained his calm, keeping a close eye on his health. If it was too dangerous, he was prepared to use the Aurora Character Summon Card or Advanced Void Travel at any time in exchange for some time to catch a breather.

At this rate, he would be beaten up sooner or later. However, Han Xiao did not panic. He was only willing to take such a high risk after careful consideration.

Facing the eight Vanguard Officials, the most dangerous period was only the beginning. The longer he dragged it out, the safer he would be.

[Advanced Strengthened Life] not only increased his health, but after the upgrade, it also gave him an ability that increased all his attributes by ten percent for every forty percent of his health lost. Endurance was also one of the attributes.

This meant that … Han Xiao's health would continue to increase as he fought!

While the maximum recovery speed of twenty-eight percent of his health would not change, the actual amount of health he would recover would continue to increase!

This Molding Talent made up for the shortcoming of his health and mana conversion, creating a wonderful chemical reaction. It was the perfect combination for his high recovery speed!

As long as he could survive the initial dangerous period, the longer he dragged it out, the less of a threat the eight Vanguard Officials would pose to him!

Apart from not having a taunt ability, Han Xiao was basically a god-tier MT!

The battle continued, and the nine of them fought fiercely. The terrifying energy fluctuations caused the surrounding Calamity Grade Supers to shrink back in fear.

Through the energy reaction of the radar, they could see that Black Star's life signal was getting stronger and stronger. Clearly, the terrifying attacks of the eight Vanguard Officials not only did not threaten his life but also made him stronger and stronger.

Even though Han Xiao was in a very difficult situation, no one dared to underestimate him!

There was only one word that could describe what everyone was feeling.

Unbelievable!

Wrothers had already realized that something was wrong. The feeling of his fists hitting his muscles was gradually changing, and he could clearly feel that Han Xiao's body was becoming stronger and stronger.

He's getting stronger and stronger!

As soon as this thought appeared in his mind, his heartstrings trembled, and an unknown anger surged within him.

Just how many trump cards does Black Star have?

He had enough!

Wrothers's chest suddenly swelled, and the flames around his body suddenly became extremely bright. All of his energy was channeled into his hands, and the muscles on his arms bulged like balloons filled with air.

Every muscle fiber in his body seemed to be stretched taut!

Veins popped out on his forehead, and Fosters seemed to be using all of his strength. His arms seemed to be pushing a mountain, and it was extremely strenuous. His movements were heavy, and a dark red ring of light appeared around his arms, surrounding his fists.

Right at this moment, the radars of the surrounding battleships started to sound alarms.

"Warning, warning! Super strong energy fluctuations detected!"

The next moment, an extremely dazzling blood-red light shot out from Wrothers's fists!

A gigantic red Shockwave Sphere with a thick tail of flames instantly blasted onto Han Xiao's body, drowning him in a blinding blood-red light.

This fist seemed to have stolen the limelight of the battlefield, and the terrifying energy fluctuations caused the spectators to imagine what was going on.

Boom!

"This is the Star Shaking Fist!"

The other seven Vanguard Officials were shocked. This was a Pugilist move that the Tyrant had personally taught them, and it was extremely energy-consuming. They treated it as their trump card and rarely used it.

They had seen the Star Shaking Fist personally unleashed by Heber, and it lived up to its name!

Wrothers was Heber's favorite student, and while his strength was far inferior to a Beyond Grade A, this fist had some of the Tyrant's style.

As these thoughts flashed through their minds, their hands did not slow down, and they all imitated Wrothers.

Eight Star Shaking Fists bombarded Han Xiao from different directions!

"What the f * ck, you all like to fight so much? Are you all Saiyans?"

The instant the attacks were about to hit him, this was the only thought that flashed through Han Xiao's mind.

The next instant, a vast amount of energy erupted!

Eight dazzling beams of light collided with each other, triggering an expansion reaction. With Han Xiao as the center, a second impact was formed!

The ball-shaped energy shockwave rapidly expanded, and its volume quickly surpassed that of the flagship. It was as though it had turned into a small planet made of energy, instantly becoming the most shocking focal point of the battlefield.

The energy ball expanded to its limit, and the next instant, a huge explosion occurred!

The dazzling light almost caused everyone to close their eyes.

There was no sound.

Dead silence.

Only ripples of shockwaves spread out, and the outer space seemed to have become a black rag that was being washed away time and time again.

The explosion ended in silence.

Before the explosion, Wrothers and the other seven Vanguard Officials had already retreated and witnessed the result of this attack from afar.

This punch had taken away more than half of their energy and stamina, and even the powerful physique of Pugilists could not take it. The eight Vanguard Officials were panting and coughing non-stop. The armor on their arms had long been shattered, and their arms were exposed. There were obvious burn marks on their skin.

Everyone's gaze was focused on the location of the explosion, but it was empty. Han Xiao's figure was nowhere to be seen.

"Was he blown to bits?" Wrothers's eyes widened in surprise.

Even he did not realize that his confidence had disappeared.

"He's really dead?" The people from Section Zero could not help but be shocked.

Right at this moment, a gray mist suddenly condensed and rapidly turned into Han Xiao's body.

The moment he regained his physical body, Han Xiao spat out a large mouthful of burnt blood. His expression was dispirited, and he looked extremely miserable. His limbs and torso were riddled with wounds, and his bones were exposed. There were burn marks everywhere.

While everyone was still in a daze, Han Xiao's wounds healed rapidly, and the flesh that was missing grew back. His dispirited expression gradually became more energetic, and in the blink of an eye, his injuries were healed, and he returned to his peak state.

Aurora Character Summon Card — [Life Return]!

"F * ck, I was almost blown to death." Han Xiaoxin still had some lingering fear.

The eight Star Shaking Punches had produced a special reaction, and the explosive power was terrifying. The Dark-star mothership's main cannon was nothing compared to this attack.

In order to withstand this attack, Han Xiao had used all his trump cards. First, he used [Repel — Thorns] to reduce the damage of the first wave of attack by 30%. Then, he transformed into Chaos Body to negate 95% of the damage, and his energy became his health.

After his energy was depleted, he regained his physical body, and his health started to plummet. At the same time, his energy was also recovering rapidly. However, the interior of the energy ball was like a furnace, and the continuous damage was insane. Fortunately, he had [Steel Body] to negate the terrifying True Damage, allowing him to recover his energy even faster. Thus, he repeatedly transformed between his physical body and Chaos Body multiple times, saving him over 100,000 health.

Unfortunately, when he was in his physical body, he was hit by the last wave of attack, and his health was almost depleted. He could only transform into Chaos Body again to dodge the attack. When he finally reappeared, his energy was zero, and his health was only left with around 8%.

He was completely out of energy!

Han Xiao could only use his final trump card, [Life Return], to recover to his peak state.

That was too close!

Han Xiao's chest heaved up and down, and he had almost died.

The scene of his flesh being regenerated was clearly displayed before everyone's eyes.

Black Star was still alive!

At this moment, the entire battlefield seemed to have stopped.

All the Calamity Grade Supers only had one thought in their minds.

That attack was definitely at the level of a Beyond Grade A!

However, Black Star … had withstood it.

They were shocked to the extreme, and they were all dumbfounded.

At this moment, the remote commander of Section Zero gave a new order.

"Retreat!"

While Han Xiao was in a stalemate with the eight Vanguard Officials, Section Zero was at a disadvantage on the battlefield, and they were still unable to expel Bloodshed Land.

One person was able to hold off eight high-level combatants, but even so, he was still unable to control the entire battle. His teammates would not become more outstanding because of this.

Only a Beyond Grade A could determine the direction of an entire galactic war!

Although Section Zero had lost again, Han Xiao had achieved his goal.

It could be said that he was the only winner of this battle!

Even the victor, Bloodshed Land, had become a backdrop for him!

Han Xiao boarded the Blacklight Stealth and retreated with the rest of the troops. Wrothers did not stop him. Firstly, he did not have much stamina left, and it was not suitable for him to go in alone. Secondly, he had already lost the confidence to kill Black Star.

The eight Vanguard Officials looked at Section Zero's retreat from afar.

Han Xiao returned, and the fleet opened up a path as though it was welcoming him back. Section Zero was clearly the side that had lost the battle and retreated, but their morale was still high.

Bloodshed Land had won this battle, but their morale seemed to have been lowered.

At this moment, those who had personally witnessed the battle between Han Xiao and the eight Vanguard Officials all knew one thing.

After this battle, Black Star would leave the realm of ordinary experts and enter a whole new level. He would truly step onto the stage of the big shots of the Star Field!
